messages.aiTrial.privacy: Inference runs on this device without a paid API or key. Unconfirmed inputs and retrieved activity data stay in page memory and clear when you leave. Do not enter email addresses, health records, or other sensitive personal data.
messages.aiTrial.download: The first model download is about 290 MB. Requires a WebGPU browser and about 1 GB available GPU memory. Some phones are unsupported. Downloaded files may remain in the browser cache.
messages.aiTrial.unsupported: This device cannot start the local model. Exact activity facts and manual entry remain available.
messages.aiTrial.cancelled: Cancelled. Unconfirmed drafts were not saved.

messages.aiTrial.draftHelp: Describe a purchase, or recognize a receipt below. AI only prepares drafts; it never saves automatically.
messages.aiTrial.questionHelp: Your question goes only to the local model. The server calculates exact amounts; AI explains them with sources.
messages.aiTrial.helpHelp: Choose an app topic to retrieve help sources. Your complete question is not sent to search.

messages.aiTrial.noSources: Not enough sources. Try another month, scope, or help topic.

messages.aiTest.title: Try AI on this device first
messages.aiTest.intro: This page loads a real Qwen model to generate responses. No account is needed, and it never saves financial entries or sends email. After signing in, find the full features under Settings → Free AI trial.
messages.aiTest.requirements: The first model download is about 290 MB; Wi-Fi is recommended. Requires a WebGPU browser and about 1 GB of available GPU memory. Some phones cannot run it. There is no paid API or automatic switch to a paid service.
messages.aiTest.privacy: Inputs and responses stay in this page's memory. Model files may remain in the browser cache. This is a small model, so check its results.
messages.aiTest.inputLabel: Describe a purchase in your own words
messages.aiTest.draftHelp: The model can only use the supplied categories and should leave unknown fields blank. This page has no button for saving entries.
messages.aiTest.noMetrics: No real inference has finished; no success rate is shown.
messages.aiTest.scopeNotice: The example check only compares fields for these two inputs. It does not establish accuracy in all situations. The website, email delivery, and production database backups have separate acceptance records.
messages.aiTest.complete: Generation finished. Draft completeness and correctness still require review.
messages.aiTest.benchmarkComplete: Synthetic example check complete. Results apply only to these two inputs.
messages.aiTest.unloaded: Model unloaded. This page's inputs and responses were cleared.
messages.aiTest.invalidDraft: The model replied, but no entry draft passed validation. Your input is preserved. Retry, or expand the original reply below to inspect it.
messages.aiTest.noOutput: The model did not produce a usable reply. Retry or shorten the input.
messages.aiTest.incomplete: The model reply did not finish, so no usable draft is available. Split the purchases into shorter sections and retry.
messages.aiTest.runtimeFailure: This operation did not complete. Check the connection and device resources, then reload the model. No paid service will be used.
messages.aiTest.timeout: This operation timed out without a usable draft. Check the connection and device resources, then reload the model.
messages.aiTest.busy: Another model operation is running. Wait for it or cancel it first.
messages.aiTest.failedMetrics: Operation failed. These measurements record a failure, not a success.
messages.aiTest.rawOutput: Inspect original model reply (draft validation failed)
messages.aiTest.rawOutputNotice: The original reply stays only on this page and may contain your input. Do not share it publicly.
messages.aiTest.extraEntry: Entry {index}: this is an extra draft.
messages.aiTest.partialBenchmark: Completed {completed} of {total} examples. Example {index} failed to run; the full check is incomplete.
messages.aiTest.benchmarkProgress: Completed {completed} of {total} examples. Waiting for the current model reply.
messages.aiTest.benchmarkSummary: {passed} of {total} examples passed. Review every result and the listed field differences.
messages.aiTest.draftMeasurement: The model replied in {seconds} seconds. Review the amounts, entry kinds and categories.
messages.aiTest.benchmarkMismatch: Some example checks did not pass. Review the highlighted field differences below. This is not a successful acceptance test.
messages.aiTest.mappedDraft: These drafts map fields from the model reply. Still check the original text, amounts, entry kinds and categories.
messages.aiTest.sourceAssistNotice: These drafts combine model extraction with source-text checks or recovery. Rules may recover entries or change fields. Review every draft; this is not the model completing the work on its own.
messages.aiTest.sourceAssistBenchmark: Model choices and source-checked drafts are checked separately. A source-checked match does not mean the model chose correctly on its own.
messages.aiTest.modelOnlySummary: Original model choices: {passed} of {total} examples match the expectations.
messages.aiTest.assistedSummary: Source-checked drafts: {passed} of {total} examples match the expectations.
messages.aiTest.scoreMissing: No separate model draft is available for comparison.
messages.aiTest.sourceChange: {field} was adjusted after checking the original text. Please confirm it.
messages.aiTest.sourceCleared: {field} could not be confirmed in the original text and was left blank. Review it and add it if needed.
messages.aiTest.ambiguousSource: This text may not describe a clear, completed income or expense. Review the entry kind and category yourself.
messages.aiTest.sourceUnverified: {field} has not been confirmed by the source-text rules. Please check it yourself.
messages.aiTest.excludedNotice: {count} model candidates failed checks against the original text or amount and were excluded. Review the retained drafts and check for any missing entries.
messages.aiTest.excludedRow: Model candidate {index} was not turned into a savable draft.
messages.aiTest.excludedSource: No matching content was found in the original text.
messages.aiTest.excludedAmount: The amount or its quoted evidence could not be verified.
messages.aiTest.excludedFields: The field format or source information could not be verified.

messages.aiTest.quickNotice: Quick checks use 4 fixed synthetic inputs. Original model decisions and source-checked drafts are scored separately.
messages.aiTest.compareNotice: Run the same model on 4 fixed synthetic inputs using both workflows: 8 runs with alternating order. Starts only when you press the button; cancel at any time.
messages.aiTest.cancelledBenchmark: Cancelled. Kept {completed} completed synthetic results. Unfinished runs do not count as passes.
messages.aiTest.noDraftExpected: The model explicitly returned no transactions. This abstention remains in the measurements.
messages.aiTest.suiteSummary: Completed {completed}/{total} runs; source-checked drafts matched all expected fields in {passed} runs.
messages.aiTest.profileScore: {profile}: original model {model}/{total}; source-checked {assisted}/{total}. Failed runs remain in the denominator.
messages.aiTest.profileTiming: {profile}: completion median after loading {median} s ({samples} measured runs).
messages.aiTest.suiteRunning: Running fixed synthetic checks. Each completed result appears immediately.
messages.aiTest.suiteComplete: Fixed synthetic checks finished. Review each result and the separate scores.
messages.aiTest.suiteNotice: These checks compare fields for these fixed inputs only; they do not establish general accuracy. Website, email, and production backup acceptance have separate records.
messages.aiTest.compareMethod: The original flow keeps the long prompt and retry policy. The compact flow shortens the prompt, targets repair errors, and skips retries for valid empty replies. Empty replies may still miss real transactions; compare each result. Starting output does not mean a draft is ready. Completion includes processing and cleanup.
